name: center_le_radical
statement: center R L ≤ radical R L

name: derivedLength_zero
statement: LieIdeal R L) [IsSolvable I] : derivedLengthOfIdeal R L I = 0 ↔ I = ⊥

name: abelian_of_solvable_ideal_eq_bot_iff
statement: LieIdeal R L) [h : IsSolvable I] : derivedAbelianOfIdeal I = ⊥ ↔ I = ⊥

have_tree.name: h₃
have_tree.body: by rintro rfl; apply h₂; apply derivedSeries_of_bot_eq_bot
